title: SysAdmin Manual Backup Execution - Success
description: Verify that an authenticated SysAdmin can trigger an on-demand manual backup, creating a current-state database dump and recording Success with timestamp.
pre_conditions: SysAdmin is authenticated and holds backup-trigger authority.
execution_steps: 1. Authenticate as SysAdmin with backup-trigger authority.
2. Navigate to backup management and initiate a manual backup.
3. System collects current timestamp and platform backup artifacts.
4. System creates a current-state database dump and records the timestamp.
5. System records and communicates Success status.
expected_outcome: Point-in-time database dump is created, backup timestamp is logged, and backup status is recorded as Success.
failure_guarantee: No corrupted backup is recorded as successful; prior database state remains unchanged.

title: Super Admin Manual Backup Execution - Success
description: Verify that an authenticated Super Admin can trigger an on-demand manual backup, satisfying the Super Admin actor-goal path.
pre_conditions: Super Admin is authenticated and holds highest system administration authority.
execution_steps: 1. Authenticate as Super Admin.
2. Trigger manual backup from administrative console.
3. System captures current platform timestamp and collects artifacts.
4. System creates database dump and records timestamp.
5. System records and communicates Success.
expected_outcome: Manual backup completes successfully, timestamped database dump is created, and Success status is recorded.
failure_guarantee: System preserves existing database state without modification on any failure.

title: Manual Backup Failure Alerting and Logging
description: Verify that when manual backup creation fails, BADMS records Failure status, logs the failure timestamp, and alerts SysAdmin within five minutes.
pre_conditions: SysAdmin is authenticated; underlying backup destination encounters an I/O error during dump creation.
execution_steps: 1. SysAdmin initiates manual backup.
2. System attempts database dump creation.
3. Dump creation encounters storage I/O failure.
4. System records backup status as Failure with timestamp.
5. System dispatches failure alert to SysAdmin within five minutes.
expected_outcome: Backup status is recorded as Failure with timestamp; SysAdmin receives failure notification.
failure_guarantee: No successful backup entry is created; prior data state is unchanged.

title: Manual Backup Trigger Authorization Denial
description: Verify that an unauthorized actor (e.g., standard User/Student) is denied permission to trigger a manual backup.
pre_conditions: User is authenticated as a standard Student/Faculty role lacking SysAdmin/Super Admin backup-trigger authority.
execution_steps: 1. Authenticate as standard User.
2. Attempt to trigger manual backup action.
3. System checks authorization for backup-trigger privilege.
4. System denies action and logs authorization failure.
expected_outcome: Action is denied with authorization error; no backup process is initiated.
failure_guarantee: Unauthorized backup trigger is blocked; system state and audit logs remain tamper-free.

title: Submit Secure Archival Request with Explicit Classification
description: Verify that an authenticated user can submit a complete secure archival request with all required metadata and explicit classification, transitioning to Submitted and routing to HoD.
pre_conditions: User is authenticated; data file is available; user has sufficient storage quota.
execution_steps: 1. User opens secure archival request form.
2. User supplies file name, date, owners, file type, reason, attachment, and initial classification 'Sensitive'.
3. System validates required fields and checks storage quota.
4. User submits the request.
5. System records request status as Submitted and routes to user's HoD.
expected_outcome: Request status becomes Submitted; request is routed to requester's HoD queue; confirmation notification is sent to user.
failure_guarantee: No invalid or incomplete request is routed; quota is not deducted until verified.

title: Submit Secure Archival Request - Default Routine Classification
description: Verify that when a user submits a secure archival request omitting initial classification, BADMS automatically assigns Routine by default.
pre_conditions: User is authenticated; data file is available; user has sufficient quota.
execution_steps: 1. User opens secure archival form.
2. User fills all required metadata but leaves initial classification empty.
3. System validates required information and detects omitted classification.
4. System applies default initial classification 'Routine'.
5. User submits request, and system sets status to Submitted routed to HoD.
expected_outcome: Request is submitted with status Submitted and initial classification set to Routine; routed to requester's HoD.
failure_guarantee: Request is not rejected for missing optional classification; default Routine is deterministically assigned.

title: Submit Secure Archival Request - Validation / Quota Failure
description: Verify that if required metadata is missing or quota validation fails, BADMS displays validation errors and preserves the unsubmitted request state.
pre_conditions: User is authenticated; requested archival size exceeds available quota or required file name is missing.
execution_steps: 1. User attempts to submit archival request with missing required fields and file size exceeding quota.
2. System executes metadata and quota validation.
3. System identifies validation errors (missing fields and quota exceeded).
4. System displays specific validation error messages.
5. Request remains unsubmitted.
expected_outcome: Validation error displayed; request state remains uncommitted/unsubmitted; no routing occurs.
failure_guarantee: No request-state change occurs on validation failure; quota is unchanged.

title: HoD Approves Secure Archival Request
description: Verify that an HoD can approve a Submitted secure archival request from their department, routing it to SysAdmin for authoritative classification.
pre_conditions: HoD is authenticated; request status is Submitted and originates from HoD's department (CS Dept).
execution_steps: 1. HoD opens routed archival request REQ-ARC-1001.
2. HoD reviews details, attachment, and departmental policy context.
3. HoD selects Approve.
4. System records decision as Approved.
5. System routes request to SysAdmin for authoritative classification.
expected_outcome: Request decision recorded as Approved; request is routed to SysAdmin queue; status updated accordingly.
failure_guarantee: Request remains in Submitted state if approval recording fails.

title: HoD Rejects Secure Archival Request
description: Verify that an HoD can reject a secure archival request from their department, setting status to Rejected and notifying the requester.
pre_conditions: HoD is authenticated; request status is Submitted within HoD's department.
execution_steps: 1. HoD opens request REQ-ARC-1002.
2. HoD reviews details and selects Reject.
3. System records decision as Rejected with specified reason.
4. System sends rejection notification to requester.
5. Request lifecycle ends in Rejected state.
expected_outcome: Request status updated to Rejected; requester receives rejection notification; request is not routed to SysAdmin.
failure_guarantee: Prior request state preserved if rejection persistence fails.

title: HoD Cross-Department Decision Denial
description: Verify that an HoD cannot approve or reject a secure archival request belonging to a different department.
pre_conditions: HoD is authenticated for Department CS; request REQ-ARC-1003 belongs to Department EE.
execution_steps: 1. HoD (CS) attempts to open or submit decision for request REQ-ARC-1003 (EE).
2. System checks department boundary enforcement.
3. System denies action due to cross-department violation.
4. System logs unauthorized access attempt.
expected_outcome: Action denied with authorization error; request state for REQ-ARC-1003 remains unchanged.
failure_guarantee: Separation of duties and departmental scope invariants are strictly enforced.

title: SysAdmin Classifies Request as Non-Sensitive (Routine/Critical/Archival)
description: Verify that when SysAdmin assigns an authoritative Non-Sensitive classification (Critical, Routine, or Archival), BADMS applies retention rules and ends workflow without routing to IT Security.
pre_conditions: SysAdmin is authenticated; request has received HoD approval.
execution_steps: 1. SysAdmin opens HoD-approved request REQ-ARC-1001.
2. SysAdmin reviews details and assigns authoritative classification 'Routine'.
3. System records classification and applies Routine retention rules.
4. System evaluates routing; because classification is non-Sensitive, no encryption routing is triggered.
expected_outcome: Authoritative classification 'Routine' recorded; request reaches ready/classified state; not routed to IT Security.
failure_guarantee: Prior request state preserved; no unapproved classification committed.

title: SysAdmin Classifies Request as Sensitive - Route to IT Security
description: Verify that when SysAdmin assigns authoritative classification 'Sensitive', BADMS applies Sensitive security/retention rules and routes the request to IT Security Team.
pre_conditions: SysAdmin is authenticated; request has received HoD approval.
execution_steps: 1. SysAdmin opens HoD-approved request REQ-ARC-1004.
2. SysAdmin selects authoritative classification 'Sensitive'.
3. System applies Sensitive security and retention policy rules.
4. System detects Sensitive classification and automatically routes request to IT Security Team queue.
expected_outcome: Authoritative classification 'Sensitive' recorded; request is routed to IT Security Team for encryption configuration.
failure_guarantee: No Sensitive data is archived without IT Security encryption routing.

title: Classification Persistence Failure Handling
description: Verify that if saving the authoritative classification fails, BADMS preserves the prior request state and reports an error.
pre_conditions: SysAdmin is authenticated; HoD-approved request is open; database persistence failure simulated on save.
execution_steps: 1. SysAdmin selects classification 'Critical' and submits.
2. System encounters database commit error while saving classification.
3. System reports error to SysAdmin.
4. System rolls back transaction to preserve prior request state.
expected_outcome: Error message presented to SysAdmin; request remains in HoD-approved state without committed classification.
failure_guarantee: No partial or uncommitted classification is stored; prior request state is intact.

title: Configure Sensitive-Data Encryption with AES-256
description: Verify that IT Security can configure encryption for a Sensitive request, applying AES-256 protection at rest and in transit, and creating the encrypted archive.
pre_conditions: IT Security member is authenticated; request is authoritatively classified Sensitive and routed to IT Security.
execution_steps: 1. IT Security member opens routed request REQ-ARC-1004.
2. IT Security configures encryption settings with AES-256 cipher.
3. System applies AES-256 protection at rest and in transit.
4. System creates encrypted archive and records operation result.
expected_outcome: Encrypted archive is successfully generated using AES-256; operation result is recorded; archive status is secured.
failure_guarantee: No plaintext or weakly encrypted Sensitive archive is persisted.

title: Encryption and Archive Creation Failure
description: Verify that if encryption or archive creation fails, BADMS records the failure and preserves recoverable request history.
pre_conditions: IT Security member is authenticated; cryptographic key provider is unreachable.
execution_steps: 1. IT Security initiates encryption configuration.
2. System attempts cryptographic archive generation.
3. Cryptographic service fails.
4. System records failure status in request log.
5. System preserves existing request state for retry.
expected_outcome: Failure is recorded; error displayed to IT Security; request history remains recoverable.
failure_guarantee: No unencrypted or partially encrypted archive is saved as valid.

title: Execute Scheduled Automatic Backup with Local Schedule Precedence
description: Verify that when a scheduled time arrives and a dataset has a local schedule, BADMS uses the local schedule over the global schedule, transfers data to recovery storage, verifies integrity, and logs Success.
pre_conditions: Scheduled execution time is reached; dataset 'DS-01' has an active local schedule; target repository is reachable.
execution_steps: 1. Scheduled trigger event fires at 02:00.
2. System checks effective schedule for DS-01 and selects the local schedule over global schedule.
3. System identifies eligible datasets.
4. System transfers dataset data to backup recovery storage.
5. System verifies backup integrity and consistency.
6. System records timestamp and backup status Success.
expected_outcome: Backup executes according to local schedule; integrity verified; Success status and timestamp logged.
failure_guarantee: No data is transferred or verified under incorrect schedule parameters.

title: Execute Scheduled Automatic Backup - Global Schedule Fallback
description: Verify that when no local schedule exists for a dataset, BADMS applies the institution-wide global backup schedule.
pre_conditions: Scheduled execution time is reached; dataset 'DS-02' has no local schedule; global schedule is active.
execution_steps: 1. Scheduled trigger event fires.
2. System determines effective schedule for DS-02 and finds no local schedule.
3. System falls back to global backup schedule.
4. System identifies eligible data and executes backup transfer.
5. System verifies consistency and records Success with timestamp.
expected_outcome: Global schedule is applied; backup succeeds; outcome is logged with Success status.
failure_guarantee: Dataset without local schedule is not omitted from scheduled global backup.

title: Scheduled Automatic Backup Repository Unreachable Failure
description: Verify that when backup repository is unreachable during scheduled backup, BADMS logs Failure, alerts SysAdmin within five minutes, and evaluates consecutive failures.
pre_conditions: Scheduled time is reached; backup recovery storage repository is offline/unreachable; failure count is currently 0.
execution_steps: 1. Scheduled trigger event fires.
2. System attempts connection to target recovery storage repository.
3. Connection fails (repository unreachable).
4. System records Failure status and timestamp in backup log.
5. System dispatches alert to SysAdmin within five minutes.
6. System increments consecutive failure counter to 1.
expected_outcome: Failure status logged; SysAdmin alerted within 5 minutes; consecutive failure counter updated.
failure_guarantee: System does not report false completion; data state remains intact.

title: Three Consecutive Backup Failures Escalation to Director of IT
description: Verify that upon the third consecutive backup failure, BADMS escalates the failure alert directly to the Director of IT.
pre_conditions: Two consecutive backup failures have already occurred (consecutive_failures = 2); third scheduled backup fails.
execution_steps: 1. Scheduled backup initiates and encounters failure.
2. System logs Failure status.
3. System alerts SysAdmin.
4. System increments consecutive failure counter to 3.
5. System evaluates consecutive-failure threshold (threshold = 3).
6. System triggers escalation notification to Director of IT.
expected_outcome: Third consecutive failure detected; escalation notification dispatched to Director of IT and SysAdmin alerted.
failure_guarantee: Consecutive failure counter is strictly maintained; escalation notification cannot be bypassed.

title: Submit Storage-Extension Request on Full Quota
description: Verify that when a user's storage quota is full, they can submit a storage-extension request with requested extension and justification, routing to HoD.
pre_conditions: User is authenticated; user's current storage quota condition is full (usage >= quota).

data_values.justification: Genomic dataset analysis for funded project

execution_steps: 1. User opens storage-extension request form.
2. User enters requested extension size (100 GB) and justification.
3. System validates current storage usage (quota full) and available infrastructure info.
4. User submits the request.
5. System records request as Submitted, routes it to user's HoD, and confirms submission.
expected_outcome: Storage-extension request submitted with status Submitted; routed to requester's HoD.
failure_guarantee: Storage extension is not granted immediately; no quota change occurs prior to HoD decision.

title: Submit Storage-Extension Request - Validation Failure
description: Verify that if storage-extension request validation fails (e.g. quota not full, or missing justification/extension), BADMS displays errors and does not submit.
pre_conditions: User is authenticated; user's storage quota is not full (e.g., 20 GB used out of 50 GB quota).
execution_steps: 1. User opens storage-extension form.
2. User attempts submission with quota not full and empty justification.
3. System validates current usage against quota and required fields.
4. System detects quota not full and missing justification.
5. System displays validation errors and blocks submission.
expected_outcome: Validation errors displayed; request is not created or submitted; request state remains empty.
failure_guarantee: No request-state change occurs on validation failure.

title: HoD Approves Storage-Extension Request
description: Verify that HoD reviews a storage-extension request from their department and records Approved, notifying the requester.
pre_conditions: HoD is authenticated; storage-extension request is Submitted and belongs to HoD's department.
execution_steps: 1. HoD opens routed storage-extension request REQ-EXT-2001.
2. HoD reviews details, attachments, available infrastructure, and justification.
3. HoD selects Approve.
4. System records decision as Approved.
5. System sends decision notification to requester.
expected_outcome: Decision is recorded as Approved; requester receives notification; workflow concludes as per v1.2 scope.
failure_guarantee: No decision state change occurs if processing fails.

title: HoD Rejects Storage-Extension Request
description: Verify that HoD can reject a storage-extension request for their department, recording Rejected and notifying the requester.
pre_conditions: HoD is authenticated; storage-extension request is Submitted and belongs to HoD's department.
execution_steps: 1. HoD opens request REQ-EXT-2002.
2. HoD reviews details and selects Reject.
3. System records decision as Rejected with reason.
4. System sends rejection notification to requester.
expected_outcome: Decision is recorded as Rejected; notification sent to requester; request ends in Rejected state.
failure_guarantee: Prior request state preserved on decision processing failure.

title: HoD Storage-Extension Decision Cross-Department Denial
description: Verify that an HoD cannot decide a storage-extension request belonging to another department.
pre_conditions: HoD is authenticated for Department CS; request REQ-EXT-2003 belongs to Department Mechanical Eng.
execution_steps: 1. HoD (CS) attempts to submit a decision on request REQ-EXT-2003 (ME).
2. System checks HoD department scope.
3. System detects cross-department mismatch and denies decision action.
4. System logs unauthorized attempt.
expected_outcome: Action denied with authorization error; request REQ-EXT-2003 remains in Submitted state.
failure_guarantee: Department scope boundary invariant is preserved.

title: SysAdmin Creates New Local Backup Schedule
description: Verify that SysAdmin can create a new local/dataset backup schedule specifying frequency, time, and classification filters, which is validated, applied, and logged.
pre_conditions: SysAdmin is authenticated and authorized.
execution_steps: 1. SysAdmin opens Backup Policies configuration.
2. SysAdmin selects Create New Local Schedule.
3. SysAdmin sets dataset 'DS-FINANCE', frequency 'daily', time '01:30', filters ['Sensitive', 'Critical'].
4. SysAdmin saves the schedule.
5. System validates parameters, applies schedule, and logs configuration change.
expected_outcome: Local backup schedule is created and saved; configuration change is logged; schedule is effective for DS-FINANCE.
failure_guarantee: No invalid schedule is persisted; preexisting schedules unaffected.

title: SysAdmin Modifies Existing Local Backup Schedule
description: Verify that SysAdmin can modify an existing local backup schedule, updating time and frequency, with changes validated, applied, and logged.
pre_conditions: SysAdmin is authenticated; schedule 'SCHED-LOC-01' already exists for dataset 'DS-HR'.
execution_steps: 1. SysAdmin opens existing schedule SCHED-LOC-01.
2. SysAdmin updates frequency to 'weekly' and time to '03:00'.
3. SysAdmin saves changes.
4. System validates parameters and updates schedule.
5. System logs schedule update event.
expected_outcome: Schedule SCHED-LOC-01 updated with new parameters; update logged in audit history.
failure_guarantee: Prior schedule parameters remain in effect if validation or commit fails.

title: Local Backup Schedule Parameter Validation Failure
description: Verify that if local backup schedule parameters are invalid or conflicting, BADMS displays validation errors and leaves existing effective schedule unchanged.
pre_conditions: SysAdmin is authenticated; schedule SCHED-LOC-01 is currently active.
execution_steps: 1. SysAdmin enters invalid frequency 'invalid_frequency' and malformed time '25:99'.
2. SysAdmin attempts to save.
3. System validates schedule parameters.
4. System identifies invalid parameters and generates validation errors.
5. System retains preexisting schedule without modification.
expected_outcome: Validation error displayed; invalid schedule rejected; preexisting schedule remains effective.
failure_guarantee: No invalid schedule is applied to any dataset.

title: Super Admin Performs Special Archival Operation
description: Verify that Super Admin can perform a special archival operation for extended storage of Sensitive research data after receiving an offline request, recording outcome and audit event.
pre_conditions: Super Admin is authenticated and authorized; offline request has been received from an authority.
execution_steps: 1. Super Admin opens special archival operation function.
2. Super Admin identifies target research data DATA-RES-SENSITIVE-99 from offline request.
3. Super Admin triggers special archival operation for extended storage.
4. System performs archival operation.
5. System records operation outcome and logs audit event.
expected_outcome: Special archival operation completes successfully; outcome and audit event recorded in BADMS.
failure_guarantee: No successful completion recorded if operation fails; prior data state preserved.

title: Special Archival Operation Execution Failure
description: Verify that if special archival operation cannot be completed, BADMS preserves the prior stored data state and reports error to Super Admin.
pre_conditions: Super Admin is authenticated; underlying archive storage is in read-only lock.
execution_steps: 1. Super Admin executes special archival operation.
2. System encounters storage lock error during archival.
3. System aborts operation and rolls back changes.
4. System reports error to Super Admin.
5. System preserves prior data state.
expected_outcome: Error reported to Super Admin; operation not recorded as completed; prior stored data state unchanged.
failure_guarantee: Prior stored-data state is preserved; no corrupted special archive is created.

title: Special Archival Operation Non-Super Admin Authorization Denial
description: Verify that any actor other than Super Admin (e.g. SysAdmin or User) is denied access to perform special archival operations in BADMS.
pre_conditions: Actor is authenticated as SysAdmin or standard User.
execution_steps: 1. Non-Super Admin actor attempts to access special archival function.
2. System checks authorization role.
3. System identifies actor lacks Super Admin role.
4. System denies action and logs authorization violation.
expected_outcome: Access denied; authorization error returned; special archival operation blocked.
failure_guarantee: Super Admin exclusive authority for BADMS special archival operations is enforced.

title: Super Admin Defines Global Backup Schedules and Defaults
description: Verify that Super Admin can define institution-wide global backup schedules and default backup policies, which are validated, applied, and recorded.
pre_conditions: Super Admin is authenticated and holds highest backup-policy configuration authority.
execution_steps: 1. Super Admin opens global backup-policy configuration.
2. Super Admin reviews current global defaults.
3. Super Admin defines updated global schedule (daily at 02:00) and default policies.
4. System validates configuration parameters.
5. System applies global schedule and records change in configuration log.
expected_outcome: Global backup schedule and default policy updated; applied institution-wide where no local schedule exists.
failure_guarantee: Prior global configuration remains effective if validation or application fails.

title: Invalid Global Backup Schedule Configuration Rejected
description: Verify that invalid global schedule parameters are rejected and prior global configuration is retained.
pre_conditions: Super Admin is authenticated; valid prior global schedule is in place.
execution_steps: 1. Super Admin inputs invalid schedule parameters.
2. Super Admin attempts to apply configuration.
3. System validates parameters against BR-BA-012.
4. System detects syntax and range errors.
5. System rejects update and preserves prior configuration.
expected_outcome: Validation error displayed; configuration update rejected; existing global schedule unchanged.
failure_guarantee: No malformed global backup schedule is applied.

title: Non-Super Admin Denied Global Backup Policy Configuration
description: Verify that SysAdmin or IT Security cannot define institution-wide global backup schedules, upholding Super Admin exclusive authority.
pre_conditions: Actor is authenticated as SysAdmin or IT Security.
execution_steps: 1. SysAdmin attempts to access global backup schedule configuration.
2. System checks highest backup-policy configuration authority.
3. System identifies caller is not Super Admin.
4. System denies access and logs authorization failure.
expected_outcome: Access denied; SysAdmin blocked from modifying global backup schedules.
failure_guarantee: Global backup policy configuration remains exclusively restricted to Super Admin.

title: SysAdmin Views Operational Audit Logs and Activity History
description: Verify that an authenticated SysAdmin can view operational audit records containing timestamps, actor identifiers, actions, and outcomes.
pre_conditions: SysAdmin is authenticated and authorized for operational log access; audit records exist in BADMS.
execution_steps: 1. SysAdmin opens audit/activity-log view.
2. SysAdmin selects operational scope for last 24 hours.
3. System retrieves and displays matching audit records with timestamps, actor IDs, actions, and outcomes.
4. SysAdmin reviews the records.
expected_outcome: Audit records displayed accurately matching requested scope; no records modified.
failure_guarantee: Viewing logs does not modify or delete any audit record.

title: Unauthorized Actor Denied Access to Audit Logs
description: Verify that an unprivileged user attempting to access audit logs is denied access without changing audit data.
pre_conditions: Actor is authenticated as standard Student/Staff User.
execution_steps: 1. Student User attempts to access audit/activity log view.
2. System verifies authorization for audit log access.
3. System determines user lacks privilege.
4. System returns access denied error without disclosing log contents.
expected_outcome: Access denied error returned; audit log contents concealed; audit data unchanged.
failure_guarantee: No audit data is exposed to unauthorized users; audit log integrity preserved.

title: IT Security Audits Data Activity and Reviews Security Reports
description: Verify that an authenticated IT Security member can inspect data activity records and security reports to detect unauthorized access and policy compliance.
pre_conditions: IT Security member is authenticated and authorized for security auditing.
execution_steps: 1. IT Security member opens security audit/reporting interface.
2. Actor selects security report scope for unauthorized access attempts.
3. System displays security-relevant logs and generated reports.
4. Actor reviews data activity records.
expected_outcome: Security reports and data activity records displayed; potential security violations highlighted.
failure_guarantee: Source log data remains unchanged during audit review.

title: Unauthorized Actor Denied Security Reports Access
description: Verify that a non-IT Security actor attempting to view security audit reports is denied access.
pre_conditions: Actor is authenticated as Faculty User or SysAdmin without IT Security privileges.
execution_steps: 1. User attempts to access security audit reports endpoint.
2. System performs RBAC check for IT Security privilege.
3. System denies access and generates security alert/error.
4. System prevents report rendering.
expected_outcome: Access denied; report retrieval blocked; security information protected.
failure_guarantee: Security audit data is inaccessible to non-IT Security roles.

title: Authorized Actor Views Backup History and Status Within Permitted Scope
description: Verify that an authorized actor (SysAdmin or User) can view timestamped backup records and Success/Failure status within their authorized scope.
pre_conditions: Actor is authenticated; backup records exist within actor's permitted view scope.
execution_steps: 1. Actor opens backup history and status view.
2. System evaluates actor's authorized viewing scope.
3. System retrieves and displays timestamped backup records with Success/Failure status.
expected_outcome: Backup history displayed showing timestamp, target dataset, and Success/Failure status within permitted scope.
failure_guarantee: No backup state is changed during viewing.

title: Backup History Access Denied for Out-of-Scope Request
description: Verify that an actor attempting to access backup history outside their authorized scope is denied access.
pre_conditions: User is authenticated as Student User; attempts to query institution-wide system backup history.
execution_steps: 1. Student User requests backup history for system core infrastructure.
2. System checks actor's authorization for requested scope.
3. System denies request due to scope boundary violation.
4. System returns access denied error.
expected_outcome: Access denied; out-of-scope backup history is concealed.
failure_guarantee: Scope restriction invariants are enforced; unauthorized details are not leaked.

title: User Tracks Owned Request Status and History
description: Verify that an authenticated user can view the current status, timestamps, and decision history of their own submitted archival/extension/restoration requests.
pre_conditions: User is authenticated; request REQ-ARC-1001 was submitted by this user.
execution_steps: 1. User navigates to My Requests / Request Tracking.
2. User selects request REQ-ARC-1001.
3. System verifies ownership.
4. System displays current status, submission timestamp, and available decision history.
expected_outcome: Accurate status (e.g. Submitted, Approved, or Rejected) and complete timeline displayed to user.
failure_guarantee: Request tracking is strictly read-only; no request state is modified.

title: Request Tracking Non-Owner Access Concealment
description: Verify that if a user attempts to track a request not owned by them or non-existent, BADMS does not disclose the request.
pre_conditions: User A is authenticated; request REQ-ARC-9999 belongs to User B.
execution_steps: 1. User A attempts to view tracking details for REQ-ARC-9999.
2. System checks request ownership.
3. System identifies request does not belong to User A.
4. System returns not found / unauthorized error without disclosing details.
expected_outcome: Request details are not disclosed; system returns error.
failure_guarantee: Privacy and isolation between users are maintained; no data leakage occurs.

title: Request Restoration of Sensitive Data - SysAdmin Approval Required
description: Verify that when a user requests restoration of archived data classified Sensitive, BADMS records the request and routes it for SysAdmin approval.
pre_conditions: User is authenticated; requested archived data 'ARCH-SENS-10' is classified Sensitive; user has permission to request.
execution_steps: 1. User selects archived dataset ARCH-SENS-10 and submits restoration request.
2. System records restoration request.
3. System inspects data classification and identifies Sensitive.
4. System places request in Pending SysAdmin Approval state and routes it to SysAdmin.
expected_outcome: Restoration request recorded; flagged as requiring SysAdmin approval; routed to SysAdmin queue.
failure_guarantee: Sensitive data is never restored directly without SysAdmin approval.

title: Request Restoration of Non-Sensitive Data - Standard Path
description: Verify that when a user requests restoration of Non-Sensitive archived data, BADMS routes it to the standard restoration path without requiring SysAdmin approval.
pre_conditions: User is authenticated; requested archive 'ARCH-ROUT-20' is classified Routine (Non-Sensitive).
execution_steps: 1. User submits restoration request for archive ARCH-ROUT-20.
2. System records request.
3. System checks classification and confirms Routine (Non-Sensitive).
4. System permits standard restoration path without routing for SysAdmin approval.
expected_outcome: Request recorded and queued for standard technical restoration execution without SysAdmin approval hurdle.
failure_guarantee: Restoration parameters validated; classification accurately observed.

title: Request Data Restoration - Missing Archive or Access Denial
description: Verify that if requested archive cannot be located or requester lacks access permissions, BADMS rejects the restoration request.
pre_conditions: User is authenticated; archive identifier does not exist in BADMS archive index.
execution_steps: 1. User submits restoration request for non-existent archive ARCH-NONEXISTENT-999.
2. System searches archive repository.
3. System fails to locate archive.
4. System rejects request and returns error to requester.
expected_outcome: Restoration request rejected; clear error returned; no restoration process initiated.
failure_guarantee: No ghost restoration requests created; system integrity maintained.

title: SysAdmin Approves Sensitive Data Restoration Request
description: Verify that SysAdmin can approve a pending Sensitive data restoration request, marking it Approved, notifying requester, and enabling technical execution.
pre_conditions: SysAdmin is authenticated; restoration request REQ-REST-3001 is for Sensitive data and is pending approval.
execution_steps: 1. SysAdmin opens restoration request REQ-REST-3001.
2. SysAdmin reviews request details and security context.
3. SysAdmin approves request.
4. System records decision as Approved.
5. System notifies requester and transitions request to eligible for technical restoration.
expected_outcome: Request marked Approved; requester notified; request becomes eligible for technical restoration execution.
failure_guarantee: Request state remains Pending Approval if approval persistence fails.

title: SysAdmin Rejects Sensitive Data Restoration Request
description: Verify that SysAdmin can reject a Sensitive data restoration request, setting status to Rejected and notifying the requester.
pre_conditions: SysAdmin is authenticated; restoration request REQ-REST-3002 is for Sensitive data and pending approval.
execution_steps: 1. SysAdmin opens request REQ-REST-3002.
2. SysAdmin selects Reject with specified security rationale.
3. System records decision as Rejected.
4. System notifies requester of rejection.
expected_outcome: Request status set to Rejected; requester notified; request ineligible for technical execution.
failure_guarantee: Rejected request cannot proceed to restoration execution.

title: Restoration Decision Recording Failure Preserves Prior State
description: Verify that if recording the SysAdmin restoration decision fails, BADMS preserves the prior request state and reports an error.
pre_conditions: SysAdmin is authenticated; database error simulated upon decision save.
execution_steps: 1. SysAdmin submits approval for REQ-REST-3003.
2. System encounters database write failure.
3. System reports error to SysAdmin.
4. System rolls back transaction to preserve previous pending state.
expected_outcome: Error reported; request remains in previous pending state; no partial decision committed.
failure_guarantee: Prior request state is preserved on failure; no ghost approvals exist.

title: Non-SysAdmin Restoration Approval Authorization Denial
description: Verify that a non-SysAdmin actor (e.g. HoD or standard User) attempting to approve Sensitive data restoration is denied authorization.
pre_conditions: Actor is authenticated as HoD or standard User; request REQ-REST-3001 is pending approval.
execution_steps: 1. HoD attempts to approve Sensitive restoration request REQ-REST-3001.
2. System checks authorization for Sensitive restoration approval.
3. System identifies that only SysAdmin holds this approval authority in BADMS baseline.
4. System denies action.
expected_outcome: Action denied with authorization error; request status remains unchanged.
failure_guarantee: SysAdmin exclusive approval authority for Sensitive restoration is strictly enforced.

title: SysAdmin Executes Technical Data Restoration Successfully
description: Verify that SysAdmin can execute technical restoration for an eligible request, retrieving archived data, restoring it to authorized destination, and logging the event.
pre_conditions: SysAdmin is authenticated; restoration request REQ-REST-3001 has satisfied all required approvals/checks.
execution_steps: 1. SysAdmin initiates technical restoration for eligible request REQ-REST-3001.
2. System retrieves archived data from archive storage.
3. System restores data to authorized destination.
4. System records restoration event in audit log and marks request completed.
expected_outcome: Archived data restored to authorized destination; restoration event logged; status updated to Restored/Completed.
failure_guarantee: Data is restored only to authorized destinations; complete audit log preserved.

title: Technical Data Restoration Failure Handling
description: Verify that if retrieval or restoration fails during technical execution, BADMS records failure and preserves audit history.
pre_conditions: SysAdmin initiates restoration; destination disk runs out of space during file write.
execution_steps: 1. SysAdmin initiates technical restoration.
2. System attempts data write to destination.
3. Destination disk full error occurs.
4. System halts restoration and records failure.
5. System logs restoration failure event in audit log.
expected_outcome: Restoration failure recorded; error communicated to SysAdmin; audit history preserved.
failure_guarantee: No corrupted or partially restored file is marked as successfully restored.

title: Technical Data Restoration Precondition Guard - Unapproved Sensitive Request Blocked
description: Verify that technical restoration cannot be executed for a Sensitive data request that has not received SysAdmin approval.
pre_conditions: Restoration request REQ-REST-3004 is for Sensitive data and is in Pending Approval state (unapproved).
execution_steps: 1. SysAdmin attempts to trigger technical restoration on unapproved request REQ-REST-3004.
2. System verifies prerequisite approval state.
3. System identifies missing approval prerequisite.
4. System blocks execution.
expected_outcome: Execution blocked; error returned indicating required approvals not satisfied.
failure_guarantee: Unapproved Sensitive data cannot undergo restoration.

title: IT Security Updates RBAC Permissions
description: Verify that an authenticated IT Security member can modify user/role RBAC permission assignments, with changes validated, applied, and logged.
pre_conditions: IT Security member is authenticated and authorized for RBAC administration.
execution_steps: 1. IT Security member opens RBAC administration.
2. Actor selects target user and updates permission assignments.
3. System validates requested role and permission assignment.
4. System applies RBAC update.
5. System records permission-change event in audit log.
expected_outcome: RBAC permissions updated; change logged in audit trail; new permissions active.
failure_guarantee: Prior permissions remain effective if validation or save fails.

title: Unauthorized Actor Denied RBAC Management
description: Verify that a non-IT Security actor (e.g. SysAdmin or User) attempting to modify RBAC permissions is rejected and permissions remain unchanged.
pre_conditions: Actor is authenticated as SysAdmin without IT Security authorization.
execution_steps: 1. SysAdmin attempts to submit RBAC role assignment change.
2. System checks authorization for RBAC management.
3. System detects actor is not IT Security Team.
4. System rejects change and retains existing permissions.
expected_outcome: Action rejected with authorization error; permissions remain unchanged; violation logged.
failure_guarantee: Separation of duties invariant enforced; only IT Security manages RBAC.

title: IT Security Configures Institution Security Policies
description: Verify that IT Security can configure institution security policies governing encryption standards and access controls, and changes are validated and logged.
pre_conditions: IT Security member is authenticated and authorized.
execution_steps: 1. IT Security member opens security-policy administration.
2. Actor reviews current policy settings.
3. Actor updates policy to mandate AES-256 encryption at rest and in transit.
4. System validates parameters and applies policy configuration.
5. System logs configuration change.
expected_outcome: Security policy configuration updated and active; configuration change logged.
failure_guarantee: Prior security policy remains active if validation fails.

title: Invalid Security Policy Configuration Rejected
description: Verify that an invalid security policy configuration (e.g. unsupported weak cipher or attempting to configure global backup schedules) is rejected and prior configuration retained.
pre_conditions: IT Security member is authenticated.
execution_steps: 1. IT Security attempts to save invalid policy setting.
2. System validates configuration parameters against institutional security rules.
3. System rejects invalid cipher setting.
4. System retains preexisting valid security policy.
expected_outcome: Configuration rejected with validation error; preexisting policy preserved intact.
failure_guarantee: Prior configuration remains effective; no invalid policy committed.

title: HoD Views Departmental Data-Management Reports
description: Verify that an HoD can view operational backup and data-management reports scoped strictly to their own department.
pre_conditions: HoD is authenticated for Department Mechanical Eng (ME); departmental report data exists.
execution_steps: 1. HoD opens departmental reports view.
2. HoD selects Department ME and reporting period 2026-Q3.
3. System verifies departmental scope match.
4. System displays relevant departmental backup/data-management report.
expected_outcome: Departmental report displayed for Department ME; operational monitoring data visible.
failure_guarantee: No operational or report data is modified during viewing.

title: HoD Denied Access to Out-of-Department Reports
description: Verify that an HoD attempting to view operational reports for a department other than their own is denied access.
pre_conditions: HoD is authenticated for Department ME; attempts to access report for Department CS.
execution_steps: 1. HoD (ME) requests departmental report for Department CS.
2. System checks actor's assigned departmental boundary.
3. System detects out-of-department scope violation.
4. System denies access and returns authorization error.
expected_outcome: Access denied; report not displayed; department isolation maintained.
failure_guarantee: Department boundary enforcement invariant strictly maintained.

title: Storage Usage Reaches Threshold - Full-Quota Status Updated
description: Verify that when a user's stored-data usage changes and reaches/exceeds the storage threshold, BADMS updates the status to full-quota, asserting condition for extension request.
pre_conditions: User storage usage changes from 45 GB to 50 GB; user threshold/quota limit is 50 GB.
execution_steps: 1. Storage usage event occurs for user_101.
2. System obtains current usage (50 GB) and quota threshold (50 GB).
3. System compares usage with threshold and detects usage >= threshold.
4. System updates user's status to full-quota.
5. Condition becomes available to storage-extension request service.
expected_outcome: User full-quota status is asserted; user becomes eligible to submit storage-extension request.
failure_guarantee: Full-quota status is updated deterministically; threshold status reflects true usage.

title: Storage Usage Remains Below Threshold - Status Kept Below-Threshold
description: Verify that when stored-data usage changes but remains below threshold, BADMS keeps status below-threshold and does not force/assert full-quota condition.
pre_conditions: User storage usage changes from 30 GB to 49 GB; quota limit is 50 GB.
execution_steps: 1. Storage usage event occurs for user_102.
2. System obtains usage (49 GB) and threshold (50 GB).
3. System compares usage < threshold.
4. System maintains status as below-threshold.
5. Full-quota condition is not asserted.
expected_outcome: User status remains below-threshold; no full-quota condition asserted; no extension request forced.
failure_guarantee: Threshold evaluation boundary strictly preserved.

title: Storage Threshold Data Unavailable Preserves Previous Status
description: Verify that if required usage or threshold telemetry is unavailable, BADMS preserves the previous threshold status and does not assert a new full-quota condition.
pre_conditions: User's prior status is below-threshold; storage telemetry provider times out.
execution_steps: 1. Storage monitoring evaluation triggered.
2. System attempts to retrieve storage usage telemetry.
3. Telemetry provider returns unavailable/error.
4. System halts threshold update.
5. System preserves previous threshold status without asserting full-quota.
expected_outcome: Previous threshold status preserved; no false full-quota condition asserted.
failure_guarantee: The previous threshold status is preserved when a reliable evaluation cannot be completed.

title: Record User/Administrative Audit Event
description: Verify that when an auditable user or administrative action occurs, BADMS captures timestamp, actor ID, action description, and outcome, and stores the audit record.
pre_conditions: Auditable administrative action is executed (e.g. SysAdmin modifies schedule).
execution_steps: 1. Auditable action occurs in BADMS.
2. System captures current event timestamp.
3. System captures actor ID 'admin_01', action 'modify_schedule', and outcome 'Success'.
4. System stores audit record in persistent audit repository.
5. Record becomes available to authorized audit services.
expected_outcome: Timestamped audit record containing actor ID, action, and outcome successfully persisted.
failure_guarantee: Audit record contains authentic metadata; no modification permitted.

title: Record System-Originated Audit Event with Event-Source Identifier
description: Verify that when a system-originated event occurs, BADMS records the event-source identifier where no human actor identifier exists.
pre_conditions: System automated background service triggers an event (e.g. automatic backup execution).
execution_steps: 1. System background service executes an action.
2. Audit subsystem captures event timestamp.
3. System identifies absence of human actor and assigns event-source identifier 'SCHEDULER_SERVICE'.
4. System records action and outcome.
5. Audit record is stored in audit repository.
expected_outcome: Audit record stored with event-source identifier accurately documenting system-originated event.
failure_guarantee: Event-source identifier is recorded accurately where no human actor ID exists.

title: Audit Persistence Failure Safety Guarantee
description: Verify that if audit persistence encounters a failure, BADMS shall not report a fabricated audit record as successfully stored.
pre_conditions: Auditable event occurs; persistent audit storage encounters a write failure.
execution_steps: 1. Auditable event is dispatched for storage.
2. Audit storage encounters write failure.
3. System fails to persist audit record.
4. System handles failure without fabricating success.
5. Minimal safety guarantee enforced.
expected_outcome: System reports failure or handles failure gracefully; no fabricated success acknowledgment is generated.
failure_guarantee: BADMS shall not report a fabricated audit record as successfully stored.
